usage: The word '租客' (zou1 haak3) refers to a person who rents a property from a landlord.
It is used to identify the tenant in rental agreements and housing discussions.
'租客' can be used in both formal and informal contexts when talking about housing or rental situations.
In a sentence, '租客' usually functions as the subject or object noun.
It is a compound noun made up of '租' meaning rent and '客' meaning guest or customer.
